notes.title: DEMO RELEASE FOR NUCLEAR GLADIATORS 3000!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce the demo for our upcoming game! We hope you like it!
If so, please remember to wishlist the game (this helps us A LOT)

You can also leave us feedback on Discord, the game forums or other ways.
We will read all your comments and try to respond to everyone.
Don't be shy to comment!

DEMO FEATURES:
- Play the first two chapters of the first scenario
- Two playable characters
- Twitch chat integration
- Demo progress will be carried over into the final game
